_readme: UCT Setup Vocabulary v0 — DRAFT, owner approval pending. Nothing may carry a setup_name outside the APPROVED list; until approval every entry is status=candidate.

D9 ANSWERED YES (owner, 2026-09-13): the authors' own names are canonical. This vocabulary is the ONE setup-name authority; the six existing lists (setupGroups.js, setupCatalog.js, desk _SETUP_TAXONOMY, pattern_vision FOCUSED_SETUPS, voice_chart_vision list, curriculum glossary) and pattern-engine ids MAP to it via wisdom_vocab_maps (W1) and derive from it later (W6). It must never become a seventh list.
Built ONLY from the Session 0 samples (Sunday Scans 2026-08-30 + 2026-09-06; Zoom edu_videos 355 live session + 356 workshop, both 2026-09-11). Names are spelled as the authors use them.

definition_quote is verbatim ONLY for Sunday Scans (a free, publicly published newsletter). Transcript-sourced evidence is a LOCATOR (edu_videos id + cue timestamp) plus a paraphrase, because this repository is public and the live sessions / workshops are paid content. The verbatim sentences are in the Session 0 report and in the gitignored samples.
kind: setup = an entry/trigger pattern · level = a price reference that setups key off · market_signal = a context read about the market, never a ticker setup.

maps_to records which EXISTING registries already name the same idea: desk = api/services/desk_session_insights.py::_SETUP_TAXONOMY (26), engine = pattern_engine detector _PATTERN_ID (85). A null is a real gap, not an omission.
evidence_strength: strong = used as a name in 2+ segments or defined; thin = one passing use. Thin entries need an owner definition before approval.

⛔ QUOTE-FREE (W1 §0.4f / D1). This repository is public. The verbatim `definition_quote` fields and the quoted tails of 25 evidence locators were REDACTED on 2026-09-13 during the golden-v1 freeze: the repo-wide leaked-quote check found 8 golden quotes reproduced here, in a paid-source draft that the approved v1 file had already superseded. Locators stay; source text does not. tools/wisdom/golden_leak_check.py is the rail that stops it coming back.
